screen.yubyeol_canvas_grid.title: YUBYEOL's Canvas Grid Settings
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.enabled.toolt:
Turns the grid, pointer and coordinates on or off together.
Same as the toggle key (G by default).
Turn it off to look at a finished painting without the overlay.
Up close, the map texture is filtered and painted pixels bleed past their cells.
When on, the canvas is repainted from the map data the client already has,
so each pixel is a sharp square that sits exactly in its grid cell. Colours are unchanged.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.line_width.to:
Thickness of the grid lines, 1 (hairline) to 5.
Thicker is easier to see from a distance; thinner is better for fine detail.
Bold lines are drawn at twice this width.
How much the thin lines cover the painting.
Lower shows more of the picture; higher makes cells easier to count.
Bold lines and the border are always drawn stronger.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.grid_color.to:
Colour of the grid lines. Pick one that contrasts with the painting:
black on light pictures, white or yellow on dark ones.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.highlight_col:
Colour of the outline around the cell your view will paint.
Choose one that differs from the colour you are painting with.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.pointer_width:
Thickness of the outline around the cell that will be painted, 1 (hairline) to 5.
Thinner leaves the cell colour visible; thicker stands out from a distance.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.bold_lines.to:
Draws every n-th line bold so cells are quicker to count.
With an interval of 4, the 32 cells form 8 groups and a position reads as
"second cell of the third group".
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.bold_every.to:
How many cells apart the bold lines and tick labels are: 2, 4, 8 or 16.
Match it to the way your reference image is divided.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.show_labels.t:
Shows 4, 8, 12 ... along the top and left edges of the canvas,
so you can find a coordinate from your reference without counting cells.
The top-left pixel is 1.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.show_cursor.t:
While seated on the easel, outlines the cell a click would paint.
ArtMap picks the cell from your view angles, not from where the crosshair lands,
so the outline can differ from the crosshair; the outline is the one that gets painted.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.show_hud.tool:
Shows the column and row of the pointed cell in a screen corner, like "Pixel 16, 14",
for a quick comparison with your reference image.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.hud_corner.to:
Which screen corner the coordinates use.
Pick one that does not overlap chat, the minimap or other HUD mods.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.search_radius:
Only easel canvases within this distance get the grid.
With several easels, the one you face and the nearest is preferred.
Lower it if a gallery frame is picked up; raise it if the grid does not appear.
option.yubyeol_canvas_grid.reset.tooltip: Restores every setting to the values from a fresh install.
hud.yubyeol_canvas_grid.sit: Sit on the easel to see the pointer
